meta_description:
2,175 likes, 51 comments - hindash on September 22, 2026: "The ultimate foundation for sensitive, reactive skin is here. The @tower28beauty Swipe Serum Foundation is the skin safe foundation that performs.
I used shade 14.5 Redondo on @deemakhaled 
Available at @sephoramiddleeast 
With medium, buildable coverage and a natural second-skin finish. 16 hour long wear. Non-comedogenic + non-acnegenic. Fragrance free.
I paired this with the Swipe Serum Concealer in “14.0 PV” and the new Big Blender Brush and Baby Blender Brush.
Available in 36 inclusive shades.
#Tower28 #SwipeFoundation #hindash".
